# FG-REVIEW-0002

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`secret-removal`](../../ops/runbooks/secret-removal.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `purge_of_an_open_merge_requests_current_head_is_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このマージリクエストの状態では版の参照を削除・再オープンできません。先にマージリクエストをクローズするか、ソースブランチを書き換えてください。
- en: The merge request's state does not allow this: close the merge request or rewrite its source branch first.
- id: Status merge request tidak mengizinkan ini: tutup merge request atau tulis ulang branch sumbernya terlebih dahulu.

## 原因 (cause)

Either an administrator asked to purge the hidden version refs of an open merge request whose current head is one of the versions to purge (`POST /api/v1/projects/{id}/merge-requests/{iid}/version-refs/purge`, `reason=purge_requires_closed_or_rewritten`: the next version job would bring the same commit back as the head), or a merge request whose version refs were purged was to be reopened while its source branch still points at a purged commit (`POST …/merge-requests/{iid}/reopen`, `reason=reopen_at_purged_head`; ADR-0024 closing table #43). A state refusal, not a permission one: nothing was written and no ref was touched.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason`, `project_id`, `iid` and `merge_request_id` (and `version` for the purged head). Read the merge request (`gstn mr view IID --project ID`): `state` and `head_sha`. Runbook `secret-removal` lists the order of the steps.

## 対処 (fix)

Close the merge request (or force-push the source branch without the secret, which adds a new version), then purge again; to reopen a purged merge request, first move the source branch away from the purged commit.
